Pin: the preload is injected as a selective import of every core dimension + anchor symbol, so anchor symbols seed the unit symbol table (literals + slot types) without the author writing `from units.core import ...`. The `units.core` preloaded is the one the repository ships under `stdlib/units/core.ds`, on every fixture's search path ([RCTS.1.2.14]).
